name: Kanouchi Ryouko
source:
[i]The bright, recently-hired maid[/i]

She is the youngest of the Kiritani family's maids and has only recently arrived at the mansion.

She is a gentle person who is easy to be around.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/kiriya/main.html]Official Site[/url]]
